description.value: Breakfast Table is a family-owned brunch restaurant in Steveston Village, Richmond, founded in 2016 by brothers-in-law George Koay and Michael Lee and known for weaving Asian flavour influences into classic comfort-food brunch dishes. The Steveston location is the brand's second spot, expanding from its original South Granville home in Vancouver. The restaurant operates on a first-come, first-served basis with a digital waitlist, and delivery is available via DoorDash.
